The following is a list of changes made in '''patch v12.04'''.
----
{{Quote1|GOOD DAY everyone! Joy here, bringing you the latest with patch 12.04!

It’s a short one this time, but if you need a TL;DR:
*Quality of life updates for KJ’s Turret
*Updates to the Progression Hub, End of Game, and Career pages
*A handful of Agent and Map bug fixes}}

==All Platforms==
===Agent Updates===
===={{ai|Killjoy}}====
We are adding quality of life updates to Turret placement that match the cast paradigm of [[Sage]]’s [[Barrier Orb]]. This will help Killjoy players to angle their Turrets more precisely, without needing to position themselves at specific angles to cover the area they want. 
*{{abi text|Turret}}
**{{ui|Buff}} Can now be rotated while holding down ALT-FIRE. ACTIVATE now swaps Turret direction. 

===={{ai|Sova}}====
Added new [[Sova/Quotes|voicelines]] for Sova.

===Bug Fixes===
*[[Agent]]
**{{ai|Killjoy}}
***{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Fixed a bug where an enemy’s {{abi text|Nanoswarm}} could remain invisible if you moved too quickly in and out of its detection range. 
***{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Fixed a bug where an enemy’s Nanoswarm could remain invisible to you after Killjoy is suppressed. 
***{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Fixed a bug where an enemy’s Nanoswarm would not reveal to you if you are in an Intangible state, like during [[Yoru]]’s [[Dimensional Drift]] or [[Reyna]]’s [[Dismiss]] 
***{{ui|Bugfix Nerf}} Fixed a bug where Nanoswarm’s disabled effects sometimes wouldn’t play when Killjoy is suppressed. 
***{{ui|Bugfix}} Fixed a bug where {{abi text|Turret}}’s vision cone would disappear from the minimap if the player right-clicks. 
**{{ai|Jett}} 
***{{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Fixed a bug where {{abi text|Drift}}’s passive gliding SFX was audible from the other side of [[Astra]]’s [[Cosmic Divide]]. 
**{{ai|Harbor}}
***{{ui|Bugfix}} Fixed a bug where {{abi text|Storm Surge}} could briefly persist into the next round when cast right before a round ends. 
**{{ai|Fade}}
***{{ui|Bugfix}} Fixed a bug where {{abi text|Nightfall}}’s minimap indicator was slightly smaller than the actual ability. 
**{{ai|Chamber}}
***{{ui|Bugfix}} Fixed a bug where {{abi text|Trademark}} would play its reactivation SFX twice if Chamber had Suppress expiring on him. 
**{{ai|Skye}}
***{{ui|Bugfix}} Fixed an observer bug where {{abi text|Seekers}} would not show on the minimap when Skye is an attacker. 
*[[Battle Pass]]
**Fixed an issue where hitting ESC will cause the Battlepass elements to disappear/reappear instead of taking you back a page. 
*[[Maps]]
**[[Breeze]]
***{{ui|Bugfix Buff}} Various collision improvements to allow [[Vyse]]’s [[Arc Rose]] and [[Cypher]]’s [[Spycam]] to be placed on the walls. 
***{{ui|Bugfix}} Fixed multiple minor art bugs around the map. 
**General Updates
***{{ui|Bugfix}} Minor adjustments to the geometry in a few high traffic gameplay spots to eliminate unintended gaps on the map. 
*[[Store]]
**Fixed an issue where the background for the accessories store was missing. 
**Fixed an issue where the {{collection|Reaver}} [[Bandit]] shows up incorrectly as a limited edition item

===Known Issues===
*Battle Pass
**The scroll wheel currently will not work when navigating between the tiers on the battlepass or event pass. This will be fixed in patch 12.05. 
*Performance 
**Since the release of patch 12.03, some players have been experiencing significant stuttering. We have deployed a hotfix that partially fixes the stutters and are working on a more robust fix for Patch 12.04.

==PC Only==
===General Updates===
*The End of Game and Career screens have been revamped 
**The Progression, Summary, and Timeline tabs now have an updated layout. 
**After Competitive matches, a new Rank summary screen displays details about your RR gains or losses. 
**The Career and Friends’ Career pages have been updated with a new UI.

===Premier Updates===
*Take a breather and get your team ready –- the next [[Premier]] Stage starts at the beginning of Act 2 in 12.05! 
**{{ui|Adjustment}} Stage V26A2 will run for six weeks of matches instead of the usual seven 
**Teams with a Premier Score of at least 500 qualify for Playoffs on April 16 
**Matches start on Wednesday, March 18, so make sure your team is ready to go! 

===Progression Updates===
*Replaced the Battlepass tab in the top navigation bar with a Progression tab. Clicking in will bring you to a Progression Hub, which provides an at-a-glance view of your overall progression. This can include the Battlepass, weekly missions, active event passes and other progress opportunities as relevant.
